children: Australian banks still face near-term margin headwinds from mortgage competition and deposit mix shifts despite recent favorable moves in deposit pricing, Morgan Stanley analysts warn. They write in a note that September-quarter mortgage conditions look set to continue for the country's major lenders, with competition trends broadly steady and spreads at or close to multiyear lows for both owner-occupier and investor loans. While deposit pricing is slightly more favorable following recent central-bank interest-rate hikes, MS analysts warn of headwinds from a consumer shift toward term deposits. (stuart.condie@wsj.com)
